tooltip.powergrid.voltmeter.desc: §7Right-click on connectors, poles, or batteries to inspect voltage, throughput, and grid topology.§r
tooltip.powergrid.cutters.desc: §7Right-click a connector or relay to cleanly sever all attached wire connections.§r
tooltip.powergrid.treated_wood.desc: §7Creosote-treated durable lumber for utility poles and crossarms.§r
tooltip.powergrid.copper_wire.desc: §7Conductive copper wire for Low Voltage (LV) distribution.§r
tooltip.powergrid.electrum_wire.desc: §7High-conductivity gold-silver alloy wire for Medium Voltage (MV) transmission.§r
tooltip.powergrid.steel_strand.desc: §7High-tensile steel core for High Voltage (HV) long-distance cables.§r
message.powergrid.wire_start: §6[Power Grid]§r Wire run started from [%s, %s, %s]. Click destination connector or relay.
message.powergrid.wire_connected: §a[Power Grid]§r Successfully strung %s blocks of %s wire!
message.powergrid.wire_too_long: §c[Power Grid]§r Span too long! Distance is %s blocks (max: %s).
message.powergrid.cannot_connect: §c[Power Grid]§r Cannot connect wire: incompatible node or maximum connections reached.
message.powergrid.cannot_connect_tier: §c[Power Grid]§r Node does not support %s wire!
message.powergrid.wire_invalid_start: §c[Power Grid]§r Starting node is no longer valid.
message.powergrid.no_wires_to_cut: §7[Power Grid]§r No connected wires to cut.
message.powergrid.voltmeter_no_data: §7[Power Grid] No grid or energy data found at target.
tooltip.powergrid.hammer.desc_3: §7Right-click Power Cable: Toggle side connection on/off.§r
message.powergrid.cable_dismantled: §a[Power Grid]§r Power Cable cleanly snipped & retrieved.
tooltip.powergrid.street_light.desc: §7North American municipal street light. Default standby illumination (Level 7) when unpowered; boosts to brilliant golden sodium radiance (Level 15) when powered at base with 5 FE/t. Sneak-Right-Click with Engineer's Hammer toggles Dusk-to-Dawn photocell sensor.§r
tooltip.powergrid.wooden_water_wheel.des: §7Kinetic hydroelectric generator (3x3x1). Generates 10 FE/t per vertical height level of water drop when placed in flowing water. Center axle hub pushes energy out to batteries, transformers, and cables.§r
tooltip.powergrid.wooden_water_wheel.sta: §8Stack multiple water wheels along the axle shaft to pool and transfer energy directly through the stack to transformers or energy storage!§r
tooltip.powergrid.windmill_rotor.desc: §7Aerodynamic kinetic wind generator (3x3x1). Generates clean renewable energy when elevated in open air.§r
tooltip.powergrid.windmill_rotor.clearan: §eRequires at least 3 air blocks of ground clearance beneath the rotor to spin. Power increases with height above ground!§r
tooltip.powergrid.windmill_rotor.stack: §8Stack rotors along their axle line to pool and transfer energy directly into transformers, accumulators, or cables!§r
tooltip.powergrid.solar_panel.desc: §7Photovoltaic solar generator. Generates 1 FE/t when exposed to daylight. Automatically balances energy across connected panel arrays and exports power through the bottom and sides.§r
tooltip.powergrid.gold_solar_panel.desc: §7Advanced gold-doped photovoltaic generator. Generates 2 FE/t (2x baseline) in daylight with 20,000 FE buffer. Automatically balances energy across connected panel arrays and exports power through the bottom and sides.§r
tooltip.powergrid.diamond_solar_panel.de: §7Elite diamond-doped photovoltaic generator. Generates 5 FE/t (5x baseline) in daylight with 50,000 FE buffer. Automatically balances energy across connected panel arrays and exports power through the bottom and sides.§r
tooltip.powergrid.tripod_work_light.desc: §7Dual halogen job-site floodlight mounted on an industrial safety-yellow telescoping tripod stand. Right-click to toggle on/off (Light Level 15).§r
tooltip.powergrid.ceiling_shop_light.des: §7Commercial dual-tube fluorescent fixture mounted flush to ceilings. Right-click to toggle on/off (Light Level 15).§r
tooltip.powergrid.wall_floodlight.desc: §7Architectural outdoor security floodlight with dual angled heads and PIR motion-sensor styling. Right-click to toggle on/off (Light Level 15).§r
tooltip.powergrid.carriage_lantern.desc: §7Traditional coach and carriage exterior wall lantern with glowing incandescent filament bulb. Right-click to toggle on/off (Light Level 15).§r
